Professional Lighting Installation & Upgrades in Los Angeles, CA

911 Construction & Electric Inc. provides lighting installation and lighting upgrade services in Los Angeles, CA for homeowners, businesses, and property managers. From indoor lighting and recessed fixtures to outdoor, security, landscape, and energy-efficient lighting upgrades, our team delivers safe, code-compliant electrical work designed for visibility, function, and appearance.

Get your FREE

Quote Today

By pressing 'Get a FREE Quote' you are agreeing to our terms and conditions and privacy policy, and consenting to receive text messages. To unsubscribe, text STOP to 747-255-8595

Safety. Visibility. Style.

Lighting Installation & Upgrades in Los Angeles, CA Done Right

  • Customized Panel Solutions for Every Property : Every property has unique electrical demands. Whether you're upgrading an older home or expanding a commercial space in Los Angeles, we assess your current system and recommend the right panel upgrade to support your energy needs safely and efficiently.
  • Modern Equipment & Code-Compliant Installations : We install high-quality electrical panels designed to handle today’s power usage, including appliances, HVAC systems, and EV chargers. Our electricians follow all Los Angeles codes and safety standards to ensure long-term reliability and compliance
  • Local Expertise You Can Trust : With extensive experience in Los Angeles, CA, we understand the electrical challenges of older systems and growing energy demands. Our team delivers panel upgrades that improve performance, safety, and overall system longevity.
Get a Free Quote
Performance. Efficiency. Long-Term Value.

Why Lighting Installation & Upgrades Matter in Los Angeles, CA

  • Prevents Overloads & Electrical Hazards : Outdated panels can struggle with modern electrical loads, increasing the risk of overheating or fire hazards. Upgrading your panel ensures safe power distribution throughout your property.
  • Supports Modern Electrical Needs : From smart home systems to EV chargers, today’s homes and businesses require more power. A panel upgrade allows your system to handle increased demand without issues.
  • Improves Property Value & Efficiency: A new electrical panel enhances your property’s value and ensures a more efficient, reliable electrical system for years to come.
Get a Free Quote
FREQUENTLY ASKED ・ ANSWERS TO YOUR QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions About Lighting Installation & Upgrades in Los Angeles, CA

Find answers to common questions about indoor lighting, outdoor lighting, security lighting, upgrades, installation timelines, and code-compliant electrical work in Los Angeles.

How do I know if I need a panel upgrade?

We install and upgrade many types of lighting, including recessed lights, ceiling fixtures, outdoor lighting, security lighting, landscape lighting, and other interior or exterior lighting systems. We help homeowners and businesses choose practical lighting solutions based on the property and the intended use.

How long does a panel upgrade take?

Yes. Lighting upgrades can improve safety, visibility, appearance, and energy efficiency. Many property owners in Los Angeles update older fixtures to improve function, reduce maintenance issues, and get better performance from key areas inside and outside the property.

Will upgrading my panel increase my home’s value?

Some lighting projects can be completed in a single visit, while larger upgrades may take longer depending on the scope of work, wiring conditions, fixture types, and access. We provide a clear recommendation and timeline before work begins.

What areas do you serve?

911 Construction & Electric proudly provides electrical services to residential and commercial clients throughout Los Angeles and surrounding communities, including:

Altadena, Arleta, Beverly Hills, Woodland Hills, Calabasas, Canoga Park, Chatsworth, Eagle Rock, Encino, Glendale, Granada Hills, Hancock Park, Hollywood, La Cañada, La Crescenta, Los Angeles, Los Feliz, Melrose, Mission Hills, Montrose, North Hills, North Hollywood, Northridge, Oxnard, Woodland Hills, Porter Ranch, Reseda, San Fernando, San Fernando Valley, Santa Monica, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Sunland, Tarzana, Tujunga, Sun Valley, Sylmar, Thousand Oaks, Toluca Lake, Van Nuys, West Hills, and Woodland Hills.

If you’re located nearby but don’t see your area listed, feel free to contact us, we’re happy to help whenever possible.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes, 911 Construction & Electric is fully licensed and insured. We follow all local electrical codes and safety regulations to ensure every project is completed safely, legally, and to the highest professional standards. Your property and safety are always our top priority.

How quickly can you respond to emergencies?

We offer 24/7 emergency electrical services and strive to respond as quickly as possible, often within the same day depending on your location and the urgency of the issue. Whether it’s a power outage, electrical hazard, or urgent repair, our team is ready to act fast and restore safety to your property.

Do you provide written estimates?

Absolutely. We provide clear, detailed written estimates before any work begins. Our pricing is transparent, with no hidden fees, so you know exactly what to expect from start to finish.

Do you handle both residential and commercial projects?

Yes, we specialize in both residential and commercial electrical services. From small home repairs and upgrades to large-scale commercial installations and construction projects, our team has the experience and equipment to handle jobs of all sizes.

Tarzana’s Reliable Electrical Team

911 Construction & Electric Inc. proudly serves Tarzana, CA with responsive service, honest recommendations, and quality workmanship. Whether you need troubleshooting, panel upgrades, EV charging support, or emergency electrical help, our team is ready to assist.

  • Licensed & Experienced Technicians:Skilled professionals trained in residential, commercial, and industrial electrical systems.
  • Safety & Compliance:All work meets local codes and safety regulations for long-term reliability.
  • Full-Service Solutions: From minor repairs to complete construction projects, we handle it all.
  • Transparent Pricing : Honest estimates, clear communication, and no hidden costs.

What Clients Say About 911 Construction & Electric

See why homeowners and businesses in Tarzana, CA trust us for reliable electrical service, fast response, and quality workmanship.

Get a Free Quote
FREQUENTLY ASKED ・ ANSWERS TO YOUR QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions About Electrical Services in Tarzana, CA

Find answers to common questions about our electrical and construction services.

What areas do you serve?

911 Construction & Electric proudly provides electrical services to residential and commercial clients throughout Los Angeles and surrounding communities, including:

Altadena, Arleta, Beverly Hills, Tarzana, Calabasas, Canoga Park, Chatsworth, Eagle Rock, Encino, Glendale, Granada Hills, Hancock Park, Hollywood, La Cañada, La Crescenta, Los Angeles, Los Feliz, Melrose, Mission Hills, Montrose, North Hills, North Hollywood, Northridge, Oxnard, Tarzana, Porter Ranch, Reseda, San Fernando, San Fernando Valley, Santa Monica, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Sunland, Tarzana, Tujunga, Sun Valley, Sylmar, Thousand Oaks, Toluca Lake, Van Nuys, West Hills, and Woodland Hills.

If you’re located nearby but don’t see your area listed, feel free to contact us, we’re happy to help whenever possible.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes, 911 Construction & Electric is fully licensed and insured. We follow all local electrical codes and safety regulations to ensure every project is completed safely, legally, and to the highest professional standards. Your property and safety are always our top priority.

How quickly can you respond to emergencies?

We offer 24/7 emergency electrical services and strive to respond as quickly as possible, often within the same day depending on your location and the urgency of the issue. Whether it’s a power outage, electrical hazard, or urgent repair, our team is ready to act fast and restore safety to your property.

Do you provide written estimates?

Absolutely. We provide clear, detailed written estimates before any work begins. Our pricing is transparent, with no hidden fees, so you know exactly what to expect from start to finish.

Do you handle both residential and commercial projects?

Yes, we specialize in both residential and commercial electrical services. From small home repairs and upgrades to large-scale commercial installations and construction projects, our team has the experience and equipment to handle jobs of all sizes.

Sherman Oaks’ Reliable Electrical Team

911 Construction & Electric Inc. is committed to delivering safe, efficient, and high-quality electrical work throughout Sherman Oaks, CA. Our team focuses on code-compliant service, clear communication, and reliable results that property owners can count on.

  • Licensed & Experienced Technicians:Skilled professionals trained in residential, commercial, and industrial electrical systems.
  • Safety & Compliance:All work meets local codes and safety regulations for long-term reliability.

What Clients Say About 911 Construction & Electric

See why homeowners and businesses in Sherman Oaks, CA trust us for reliable electrical service, fast response, and quality workmanship.

Get a Free Quote
FREQUENTLY ASKED ・ ANSWERS TO YOUR QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions About Electrical Services in Sherman Oaks, CA

Find answers to common questions about our electrical and construction services.

What areas do you serve?

911 Construction & Electric proudly provides electrical services to residential and commercial clients throughout Los Angeles and surrounding communities, including:

Altadena, Arleta, Beverly Hills, Sherman Oaks, Calabasas, Canoga Park, Chatsworth, Eagle Rock, Encino, Glendale, Granada Hills, Hancock Park, Hollywood, La Cañada, La Crescenta, Los Angeles, Los Feliz, Melrose, Mission Hills, Montrose, North Hills, North Hollywood, Northridge, Oxnard, Sherman Oaks, Porter Ranch, Reseda, San Fernando, San Fernando Valley, Santa Monica, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Sunland, Tarzana, Tujunga, Sun Valley, Sylmar, Thousand Oaks, Toluca Lake, Van Nuys, West Hills, and Woodland Hills.

If you’re located nearby but don’t see your area listed, feel free to contact us, we’re happy to help whenever possible.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes, 911 Construction & Electric is fully licensed and insured. We follow all local electrical codes and safety regulations to ensure every project is completed safely, legally, and to the highest professional standards. Your property and safety are always our top priority.

How quickly can you respond to emergencies?

We offer 24/7 emergency electrical services and strive to respond as quickly as possible, often within the same day depending on your location and the urgency of the issue. Whether it’s a power outage, electrical hazard, or urgent repair, our team is ready to act fast and restore safety to your property.

Do you provide written estimates?

Absolutely. We provide clear, detailed written estimates before any work begins. Our pricing is transparent, with no hidden fees, so you know exactly what to expect from start to finish.

Do you handle both residential and commercial projects?

Yes, we specialize in both residential and commercial electrical services. From small home repairs and upgrades to large-scale commercial installations and construction projects, our team has the experience and equipment to handle jobs of all sizes.

What areas do you serve?

911 Construction & Electric proudly provides electrical services to residential and commercial clients throughout Los Angeles and surrounding communities, including:

If you’re located nearby but don’t see your area listed, feel free to contact us, we’re happy to help whenever possible.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes, 911 Construction & Electric is fully licensed and insured. We follow all local electrical codes and safety regulations to ensure every project is completed safely, legally, and to the highest professional standards. Your property and safety are always our top priority.

How quickly can you respond to emergencies?

We offer 24/7 emergency electrical services and strive to respond as quickly as possible, often within the same day depending on your location and the urgency of the issue. Whether it’s a power outage, electrical hazard, or urgent repair, our team is ready to act fast and restore safety to your property.

Do you provide written estimates?

Absolutely. We provide clear, detailed written estimates before any work begins. Our pricing is transparent, with no hidden fees, so you know exactly what to expect from start to finish.

Do you handle both residential and commercial projects?

Yes, we specialize in both residential and commercial electrical services. From small home repairs and upgrades to large-scale commercial installations and construction projects, our team has the experience and equipment to handle jobs of all sizes.

What areas do you serve?

911 Construction & Electric proudly provides electrical services to residential and commercial clients throughout Los Angeles and surrounding communities, including:

Altadena, Arleta, Beverly Hills, Oxnard, Calabasas, Canoga Park, Chatsworth, Eagle Rock, Encino, Glendale, Granada Hills, Hancock Park, Hollywood, La Cañada, La Crescenta, Los Angeles, Los Feliz, Melrose, Mission Hills, Montrose, North Hills, North Hollywood, Northridge, Oxnard, Oxnard, Porter Ranch, Reseda, San Fernando, San Fernando Valley, Santa Monica, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Sunland, Tarzana, Tujunga, Sun Valley, Sylmar, Thousand Oaks, Toluca Lake, Van Nuys, West Hills, and Woodland Hills.

If you’re located nearby but don’t see your area listed, feel free to contact us, we’re happy to help whenever possible.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes, 911 Construction & Electric is fully licensed and insured. We follow all local electrical codes and safety regulations to ensure every project is completed safely, legally, and to the highest professional standards. Your property and safety are always our top priority.

How quickly can you respond to emergencies?

We offer 24/7 emergency electrical services and strive to respond as quickly as possible, often within the same day depending on your location and the urgency of the issue. Whether it’s a power outage, electrical hazard, or urgent repair, our team is ready to act fast and restore safety to your property.

Do you provide written estimates?

Absolutely. We provide clear, detailed written estimates before any work begins. Our pricing is transparent, with no hidden fees, so you know exactly what to expect from start to finish.

Do you handle both residential and commercial projects?

Yes, we specialize in both residential and commercial electrical services. From small home repairs and upgrades to large-scale commercial installations and construction projects, our team has the experience and equipment to handle jobs of all sizes.

ABOUT 911 CONSTRUCTION & ELECTRICS • YOUR TRUSTED ELECTRICAL PARTNER

Mission Hills’s Reliable Electrical Team

911 Construction & Electric Inc. proudly serves Mission Hills, CA with responsive service, honest recommendations, and quality workmanship. Whether you need troubleshooting, panel upgrades, EV charging support, or emergency electrical help, our team is ready to assist.

  • Licensed & Experienced Technicians:Skilled professionals trained in residential, commercial, and industrial electrical systems.
  • Safety & Compliance:All work meets local codes and safety regulations for long-term reliability.
  • Full-Service Solutions: From minor repairs to complete construction projects, we handle it all.
  • Transparent Pricing : Honest estimates, clear communication, and no hidden costs.

CUSTOMER FEEDBACK ・ WHAT CLIENTS SAY

What Clients Say About 911 Construction & Electric

See why homeowners and businesses in Mission Hills, CA trust us for reliable electrical service, fast response, and quality workmanship.

Get a Free Quote
FREQUENTLY ASKED ・ ANSWERS TO YOUR QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions About Electrical Services in Mission Hills, CA

Find answers to common questions about our electrical and construction services.

What areas do you serve?

911 Construction & Electric proudly provides electrical services to residential and commercial clients throughout Los Angeles and surrounding communities, including:

Altadena, Arleta, Beverly Hills, Mission Hills, Calabasas, Canoga Park, Chatsworth, Eagle Rock, Encino, Glendale, Granada Hills, Hancock Park, Hollywood, La Cañada, La Crescenta, Los Angeles, Los Feliz, Melrose, Mission Hills, Montrose, North Hills, North Hollywood, Northridge, Oxnard, Mission Hills, Porter Ranch, Reseda, San Fernando, San Fernando Valley, Santa Monica, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Sunland, Tarzana, Tujunga, Sun Valley, Sylmar, Thousand Oaks, Toluca Lake, Van Nuys, West Hills, and Woodland Hills.

If you’re located nearby but don’t see your area listed, feel free to contact us, we’re happy to help whenever possible.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes, 911 Construction & Electric is fully licensed and insured. We follow all local electrical codes and safety regulations to ensure every project is completed safely, legally, and to the highest professional standards. Your property and safety are always our top priority.

How quickly can you respond to emergencies?

We offer 24/7 emergency electrical services and strive to respond as quickly as possible, often within the same day depending on your location and the urgency of the issue. Whether it’s a power outage, electrical hazard, or urgent repair, our team is ready to act fast and restore safety to your property.

Do you provide written estimates?

Absolutely. We provide clear, detailed written estimates before any work begins. Our pricing is transparent, with no hidden fees, so you know exactly what to expect from start to finish.

Do you handle both residential and commercial projects?

Yes, we specialize in both residential and commercial electrical services. From small home repairs and upgrades to large-scale commercial installations and construction projects, our team has the experience and equipment to handle jobs of all sizes.

How quickly can you respond to emergencies?

We offer 24/7 emergency electrical services and strive to respond as quickly as possible, often within the same day depending on your location and the urgency of the issue. Absolutely. We provide clear, detailed written estimates before any work begins. Our pricing is transparent, with no hidden fees, so you know exactly what to expect from start to finish.

Do you handle both residential and commercial projects?

Yes, we specialize in both residential and commercial electrical services. From small home repairs and upgrades to large-scale commercial installations and construction projects, our team has the experience and equipment to handle jobs of all sizes.

FREQUENTLY ASKED ・ ANSWERS TO YOUR QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions About Electrical Services in Chatsworth, CA

Find answers to common questions about our electrical and construction services.

What areas do you serve?

911 Construction & Electric proudly provides electrical services to residential and commercial clients throughout Los Angeles and surrounding communities, including:

Altadena, Arleta, Beverly Hills, Chatsworth, Calabasas, Canoga Park, Chatsworth, Eagle Rock, Encino, Glendale, Granada Hills, Hancock Park, Hollywood, La Cañada, La Crescenta, Los Angeles, Los Feliz, Melrose, Mission Hills, Montrose, North Hills, North Hollywood, Northridge, Oxnard, Chatsworth, Porter Ranch, Reseda, San Fernando, San Fernando Valley, Santa Monica, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Sunland, Tarzana, Tujunga, Sun Valley, Sylmar, Thousand Oaks, Toluca Lake, Van Nuys, West Hills, and Woodland Hills.

If you’re located nearby but don’t see your area listed, feel free to contact us, we’re happy to help whenever possible.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes, 911 Construction & Electric is fully licensed and insured. We follow all local electrical codes and safety regulations to ensure every project is completed safely, legally, and to the highest professional standards. Your property and safety are always our top priority.

How quickly can you respond to emergencies?

We offer 24/7 emergency electrical services and strive to respond as quickly as possible, often within the same day depending on your location and the urgency of the issue. Whether it’s a power outage, electrical hazard, or urgent repair, our team is ready to act fast and restore safety to your property.

Do you provide written estimates?

Absolutely. We provide clear, detailed written estimates before any work begins. Our pricing is transparent, with no hidden fees, so you know exactly what to expect from start to finish.

Do you handle both residential and commercial projects?

Yes, we specialize in both residential and commercial electrical services. From small home repairs and upgrades to large-scale commercial installations and construction projects, our team has the experience and equipment to handle jobs of all sizes.

Professional Electrical & Construction Services in Beverly Hills, CA

911 Construction & Electric Inc. provides professional electrical services in Beverly Hills, CA for homeowners, businesses, and property managers. From electrical repairs and panel upgrades to EV charger installation and emergency service, our team delivers safe, code-compliant work with dependable communication and reliable results.

  • Expert Electrical Solutions
  • Reliable Construction Services

Quote Today

From Consultation to Completion in 3 Easy Steps

Electrical & Construction Services Made Simple in Beverly Hills, CA

We’ve streamlined our process to get your project completed quickly, safely, and efficiently in Beverly Hills, without unnecessary delays or stress.

Schedule Your Service

Call us or request a quote online to tell us about your electrical or construction needs in Beverly Hills, CA. We’ll schedule a convenient inspection.

Detailed Assessment & Quote

Our experts perform a thorough evaluation of your Beverly Hills property and provide a clear, upfront estimate with no hidden fees.

Professional Execution

From electrical repairs and installations to full construction projects, we complete every job with precision, safety, and industry-grade expertise.

Fast and reliable diagnosis and repair of electrical issues to restore safety and functionality in your Beverly Hills home or business.

Explore service

EV Charger Installation

Explore service

Explore service

Immediate response for urgent electrical issues, outages, and safety hazards, available anytime you need us.

Explore service

ABOUT 911 CONSTRUCTION & ELECTRICS • YOUR TRUSTED ELECTRICAL PARTNER

Beverly Hills’s Reliable Electrical Team

911 Construction & Electric Inc. proudly serves Beverly Hills, CA with responsive service, honest recommendations, and quality workmanship. Whether you need troubleshooting, panel upgrades, EV charging support, or emergency electrical help, our team is ready to assist.

  • Licensed & Experienced Technicians:Skilled professionals trained in residential, commercial, and industrial electrical systems.
  • Safety & Compliance:All work meets local codes and safety regulations for long-term reliability.
  • Full-Service Solutions: From minor repairs to complete construction projects, we handle it all.
  • Transparent Pricing : Honest estimates, clear communication, and no hidden costs.
Get a Free Quote
CUSTOMER FEEDBACK ・ WHAT CLIENTS SAY

What Clients Say About 911 Construction & Electric

See why homeowners and businesses in Beverly Hills, CA trust us for reliable electrical service, fast response, and quality workmanship.

Get a Free Quote
FREQUENTLY ASKED ・ ANSWERS TO YOUR QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions About Electrical Services in Beverly Hills, CA

Find answers to common questions about our electrical and construction services.

What areas do you serve?

911 Construction & Electric proudly provides electrical services to residential and commercial clients throughout Los Angeles and surrounding communities, including:

Altadena, Arleta, Beverly Hills, Beverly Hills, Calabasas, Canoga Park, Chatsworth, Eagle Rock, Encino, Glendale, Granada Hills, Hancock Park, Hollywood, La Cañada, La Crescenta, Los Angeles, Los Feliz, Melrose, Mission Hills, Montrose, North Hills, North Hollywood, Northridge, Oxnard, Beverly Hills, Porter Ranch, Reseda, San Fernando, San Fernando Valley, Santa Monica, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Sunland, Tarzana, Tujunga, Sun Valley, Sylmar, Thousand Oaks, Toluca Lake, Van Nuys, West Hills, and Woodland Hills.

If you’re located nearby but don’t see your area listed, feel free to contact us, we’re happy to help whenever possible.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes, 911 Construction & Electric is fully licensed and insured. We follow all local electrical codes and safety regulations to ensure every project is completed safely, legally, and to the highest professional standards. Your property and safety are always our top priority.

How quickly can you respond to emergencies?

We offer 24/7 emergency electrical services and strive to respond as quickly as possible, often within the same day depending on your location and the urgency of the issue. Whether it’s a power outage, electrical hazard, or urgent repair, our team is ready to act fast and restore safety to your property.

Do you provide written estimates?

Absolutely. We provide clear, detailed written estimates before any work begins. Our pricing is transparent, with no hidden fees, so you know exactly what to expect from start to finish.

Do you handle both residential and commercial projects?

Yes, we specialize in both residential and commercial electrical services. From small home repairs and upgrades to large-scale commercial installations and construction projects, our team has the experience and equipment to handle jobs of all sizes.

Electrician in Burbank, CA for Repairs, Panel Upgrades & EV Chargers

911 Construction & Electric Inc. provides professional electrical services in Burbank, CA for residential and commercial properties. From electrical troubleshooting and panel upgrades to EV charger installation and emergency service, we help keep Burbank properties safe, powered, and ready for modern electrical demands.

  • Expert Electrical Solutions
  • Reliable Construction Services

Get your FREE

Quote Today

By pressing 'Get a FREE Quote' you are agreeing to our terms and conditions and privacy policy, and consenting to receive text messages. To unsubscribe, text STOP to 747-255-8595

From Consultation to Completion in 3 Easy Steps

Electrical & Construction Services Made Simple in Burbank, CA

We’ve streamlined our process to get your project completed quickly, safely, and efficiently in Burbank, without unnecessary delays or stress.

Schedule Your Service

Call us or request a quote online to tell us about your electrical or construction needs in Burbank, CA. We’ll schedule a convenient inspection.

Detailed Assessment & Quote

Our experts perform a thorough evaluation of your Burbank property and provide a clear, upfront estimate with no hidden fees.

Professional Execution

From electrical repairs and installations to full construction projects, we complete every job with precision, safety, and industry-grade expertise.

Get a Free Quote
OUR SERVICES • COMPLETE ELECTRICAL & CONSTRUCTION SOLUTIONS

Professional Electrical Services in Burbank, CA

From small electrical repairs to larger upgrades and construction-related electrical work, 911 Construction & Electric delivers dependable solutions tailored to homes and businesses throughout Burbank, CA.

Electrical Repairs & Troubleshooting

Fast and reliable diagnosis and repair of electrical issues to restore safety and functionality in your Burbank home or business.

Explore service

Electrical Panel Upgrades

Upgrade outdated panels to handle modern power demands safely and efficiently in Burbank properties.

Explore service

EV Charger Installation

Professional installation of electric vehicle charging stations for residential and commercial properties.

Explore service

New Construction Electrical

Complete electrical system design and installation for new residential and commercial builds.

Explore service

Emergency Electrical Services (24/7)

Immediate response for urgent electrical issues, outages, and safety hazards, available anytime you need us.

Explore service
Get a Free Quote
ABOUT 911 CONSTRUCTION & ELECTRICS • YOUR TRUSTED ELECTRICAL PARTNER

Burbank’s Reliable Electrical Team

911 Construction & Electric Inc. is committed to delivering safe, efficient, and high-quality electrical work throughout Burbank, CA. Our team focuses on code-compliant service, clear communication, and reliable results that property owners can count on.

  • Licensed & Experienced Technicians:Skilled professionals trained in residential, commercial, and industrial electrical systems.
  • Safety & Compliance:All work meets local codes and safety regulations for long-term reliability.
  • Full-Service Solutions: From minor repairs to complete construction projects, we handle it all.
  • Transparent Pricing : Honest estimates, clear communication, and no hidden costs.
Get a Free Quote
CUSTOMER FEEDBACK ・ WHAT CLIENTS SAY

What Clients Say About 911 Construction & Electric

See why homeowners and businesses in Burbank, CA trust us for reliable electrical service, fast response, and quality workmanship.

Get a Free Quote
FREQUENTLY ASKED ・ ANSWERS TO YOUR QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions About Electrical Services in Burbank, CA

Find answers to common questions about our electrical and construction services.

What areas do you serve?

911 Construction & Electric proudly provides electrical services to residential and commercial clients throughout Los Angeles and surrounding communities, including:

Altadena, Arleta, Beverly Hills, Burbank, Calabasas, Canoga Park, Chatsworth, Eagle Rock, Encino, Glendale, Granada Hills, Hancock Park, Hollywood, La Cañada, La Crescenta, Los Angeles, Los Feliz, Melrose, Mission Hills, Montrose, North Hills, North Hollywood, Northridge, Oxnard, Burbank, Porter Ranch, Reseda, San Fernando, San Fernando Valley, Santa Monica, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Sunland, Tarzana, Tujunga, Sun Valley, Sylmar, Thousand Oaks, Toluca Lake, Van Nuys, West Hills, and Woodland Hills.

If you’re located nearby but don’t see your area listed, feel free to contact us, we’re happy to help whenever possible.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes, 911 Construction & Electric is fully licensed and insured. We follow all local electrical codes and safety regulations to ensure every project is completed safely, legally, and to the highest professional standards. Your property and safety are always our top priority.

How quickly can you respond to emergencies?

We offer 24/7 emergency electrical services and strive to respond as quickly as possible, often within the same day depending on your location and the urgency of the issue. Whether it’s a power outage, electrical hazard, or urgent repair, our team is ready to act fast and restore safety to your property.

Do you provide written estimates?

Absolutely. We provide clear, detailed written estimates before any work begins. Our pricing is transparent, with no hidden fees, so you know exactly what to expect from start to finish.

Do you handle both residential and commercial projects?

Yes, we specialize in both residential and commercial electrical services. From small home repairs and upgrades to large-scale commercial installations and construction projects, our team has the experience and equipment to handle jobs of all sizes.

ABOUT 911 CONSTRUCTION & ELECTRICS • YOUR TRUSTED ELECTRICAL PARTNER

Los Angeles’s Reliable Electrical & Construction Team

911 Construction & Electric Inc. is committed to delivering safe, efficient, and high-quality electrical and construction services throughout Los Angeles, CA. Our experienced team combines technical expertise with dependable service to ensure every project is completed to the highest standards.

  • Licensed & Experienced Technicians:Skilled professionals trained in residential, commercial, and industrial electrical systems.
  • Safety & Compliance:All work meets local codes and safety regulations for long-term reliability.
  • Full-Service Solutions: From minor repairs to complete construction projects, we handle it all.
  • Transparent Pricing : Honest estimates, clear communication, and no hidden costs.
Get a Free Quote
CUSTOMER FEEDBACK ・ WHAT CLIENTS SAY

What Clients Say About 911 Construction & Electric

See why homeowners and businesses in Los Angeles, CA trust us for reliable electrical services, fast emergency response, and high-quality construction work.

Get a Free Quote
FREQUENTLY ASKED ・ ANSWERS TO YOUR QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions About Electrical Services in Los Angeles, CA

Find answers to common questions about our electrical and construction services.

What areas do you serve?

911 Construction & Electric proudly provides electrical services to residential and commercial clients throughout Los Angeles and surrounding communities, including:

Altadena, Arleta, Beverly Hills, Los Angeles, Calabasas, Canoga Park, Chatsworth, Eagle Rock, Encino, Glendale, Granada Hills, Hancock Park, Hollywood, La Cañada, La Crescenta, Los Angeles, Los Feliz, Melrose, Mission Hills, Montrose, North Hills, North Hollywood, Northridge, Oxnard, Los Angeles, Porter Ranch, Reseda, San Fernando, San Fernando Valley, Santa Monica, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Sunland, Tarzana, Tujunga, Sun Valley, Sylmar, Thousand Oaks, Toluca Lake, Van Nuys, West Hills, and Woodland Hills.

If you’re located nearby but don’t see your area listed, feel free to contact us, we’re happy to help whenever possible.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes, 911 Construction & Electric is fully licensed and insured. We follow all local electrical codes and safety regulations to ensure every project is completed safely, legally, and to the highest professional standards. Your property and safety are always our top priority.

How quickly can you respond to emergencies?

We offer 24/7 emergency electrical services and strive to respond as quickly as possible, often within the same day depending on your location and the urgency of the issue. Whether it’s a power outage, electrical hazard, or urgent repair, our team is ready to act fast and restore safety to your property.

Do you provide written estimates?

Absolutely. We provide clear, detailed written estimates before any work begins. Our pricing is transparent, with no hidden fees, so you know exactly what to expect from start to finish.

Do you handle both residential and commercial projects?

Yes, we specialize in both residential and commercial electrical services. From small home repairs and upgrades to large-scale commercial installations and construction projects, our team has the experience and equipment to handle jobs of all sizes.

Professional Electrical & Construction Services in Pasadena, CA

911 Construction & Electric Inc. delivers expert electrical installations, repairs, and full-service construction solutions for residential and commercial properties in Pasadena, CA. From emergency electrical issues to complete build-outs, we keep your property powered, safe, and fully operational.

  • Expert Electrical Solutions
  • Reliable Construction Services

Get your FREE

Quote Today

By pressing 'Get a FREE Quote' you are agreeing to our terms and conditions and privacy policy, and consenting to receive text messages. To unsubscribe, text STOP to 747-255-8595

From Consultation to Completion in 3 Easy Steps

Electrical & Construction Services Made Simple in Pasadena, CA

We’ve streamlined our process to get your project completed quickly, safely, and efficiently in Pasadena, without unnecessary delays or stress.

Schedule Your Service

Call us or request a quote online to tell us about your electrical or construction needs in Pasadena, CA. We’ll schedule a convenient inspection.

Detailed Assessment & Quote

Our experts perform a thorough evaluation of your Pasadena property and provide a clear, upfront estimate with no hidden fees.

Professional Execution

From electrical repairs and installations to full construction projects, we complete every job with precision, safety, and industry-grade expertise.

Get a Free Quote
OUR SERVICES • COMPLETE ELECTRICAL & CONSTRUCTION SOLUTIONS

Professional Electrical Services in Pasadena, CA

From small repairs to large-scale construction projects, 911 Construction & Electric delivers reliable, high-quality solutions tailored to homes and businesses throughout Pasadena, CA.

Electrical Repairs & Troubleshooting

Fast and reliable diagnosis and repair of electrical issues to restore safety and functionality in your Pasadena home or business.

Explore service

Electrical Panel Upgrades

Upgrade outdated panels to handle modern power demands safely and efficiently in Pasadena properties.

Explore service

EV Charger Installation

Professional installation of electric vehicle charging stations for residential and commercial properties.

Explore service

New Construction Electrical

Complete electrical system design and installation for new residential and commercial builds.

Explore service

Emergency Electrical Services (24/7)

Immediate response for urgent electrical issues, outages, and safety hazards, available anytime you need us.

Explore service
Get a Free Quote
ABOUT 911 CONSTRUCTION & ELECTRICS • YOUR TRUSTED ELECTRICAL PARTNER

Pasadena’s Reliable Electrical & Construction Team

911 Construction & Electric Inc. is committed to delivering safe, efficient, and high-quality electrical and construction services throughout Pasadena, CA. Our experienced team combines technical expertise with dependable service to ensure every project is completed to the highest standards.

  • Licensed & Experienced Technicians:Skilled professionals trained in residential, commercial, and industrial electrical systems.
  • Safety & Compliance:All work meets local codes and safety regulations for long-term reliability.
  • Full-Service Solutions: From minor repairs to complete construction projects, we handle it all.
  • Transparent Pricing : Honest estimates, clear communication, and no hidden costs.
Get a Free Quote
CUSTOMER FEEDBACK ・ WHAT CLIENTS SAY

What Clients Say About 911 Construction & Electric

See why homeowners and businesses in Pasadena, CA trust us for reliable electrical services, fast emergency response, and high-quality construction work.

Get a Free Quote
FREQUENTLY ASKED ・ ANSWERS TO YOUR QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions About Electrical Services in Pasadena, CA

Find answers to common questions about our electrical and construction services.

What areas do you serve?

911 Construction & Electric proudly provides electrical services to residential and commercial clients throughout Los Angeles and surrounding communities, including:

Altadena, Arleta, Beverly Hills, Pasadena, Calabasas, Canoga Park, Chatsworth, Eagle Rock, Encino, Glendale, Granada Hills, Hancock Park, Hollywood, La Cañada, La Crescenta, Los Angeles, Los Feliz, Melrose, Mission Hills, Montrose, North Hills, North Hollywood, Northridge, Oxnard, Pasadena, Porter Ranch, Reseda, San Fernando, San Fernando Valley, Santa Monica, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Sunland, Tarzana, Tujunga, Sun Valley, Sylmar, Thousand Oaks, Toluca Lake, Van Nuys, West Hills, and Woodland Hills.

If you’re located nearby but don’t see your area listed, feel free to contact us, we’re happy to help whenever possible.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes, 911 Construction & Electric is fully licensed and insured. We follow all local electrical codes and safety regulations to ensure every project is completed safely, legally, and to the highest professional standards. Your property and safety are always our top priority.

How quickly can you respond to emergencies?

We offer 24/7 emergency electrical services and strive to respond as quickly as possible, often within the same day depending on your location and the urgency of the issue. Whether it’s a power outage, electrical hazard, or urgent repair, our team is ready to act fast and restore safety to your property.

Do you provide written estimates?

Absolutely. We provide clear, detailed written estimates before any work begins. Our pricing is transparent, with no hidden fees, so you know exactly what to expect from start to finish.

Do you handle both residential and commercial projects?

Yes, we specialize in both residential and commercial electrical services. From small home repairs and upgrades to large-scale commercial installations and construction projects, our team has the experience and equipment to handle jobs of all sizes.

  • Protects Your Property from Serious Hazards: Electrical emergencies can quickly lead to fire risks, electrical shocks, or costly equipment damage. Fast professional service helps contain the problem before it becomes more dangerous.
  • Restores Power & Normal Operations Quickly: Unexpected electrical issues can disrupt your home, business, or daily routine. Our emergency electrical services help restore power quickly so you can get back to normal with minimal interruption.
  • Prevents Costly Long-Term Damage: Waiting too long to address an emergency electrical issue can make repairs more expensive. Immediate troubleshooting and repairs help reduce long-term damage and protect your electrical system

FREQUENTLY ASKED ・ ANSWERS TO YOUR QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions About Emergency Electrical Services in Los Angeles, CA

Find answers to common questions about emergency electrical problems, response times, safety steps, and urgent repair service in Los Angeles.

What qualifies as an electrical emergency?

Electrical emergencies include power outages, burning smells, sparking outlets, exposed wires, smoking electrical panels, repeated breaker trips, or any situation that poses an immediate safety risk. If you notice any of these issues, contact our team right away for emergency service.

How quickly can you respond to emergency electrical calls?

We offer 24/7 emergency electrical services in Los Angeles, CA and strive to respond as quickly as possible based on your location and the severity of the issue. Our goal is to restore safety and power fast.

Should I turn off power before calling for emergency electrical repairs?

If it is safe to do so, shutting off power to the affected area can help reduce risk before our electricians arrive. However, if you are unsure or the situation appears dangerous, keep a safe distance and call us immediately for guidance.

Professional Electrical Repairs & Troubleshooting in Los Angeles, CA

911 Construction & Electric Inc. provides electrical repair and troubleshooting services in Los Angeles, CA for homes, businesses, and property managers. From flickering lights and dead outlets to breaker problems, wiring issues, and urgent electrical hazards, our team delivers safe, code-compliant repairs with clear communication and dependable response.

Get your FREE

Quote Today

By pressing 'Get a FREE Quote' you are agreeing to our terms and conditions and privacy policy, and consenting to receive text messages. To unsubscribe, text STOP to 747-255-8595

Safety. Precision. Reliability.

Expert Electrical Repairs in Los Angeles, CA

  • Accurate Diagnosis for Every Issue:Electrical problems can be complex and dangerous if not handled properly. Whether you're dealing with flickering lights, circuit breaker issues, or power outages in Los Angeles, our team performs detailed inspections to quickly identify the root cause and provide effective solutions.
  • Advanced Tools & Safe Repairs :We use professional-grade tools and proven repair techniques to handle everything from minor electrical faults to major system failures. Our electricians follow strict safety standards and local codes to ensure every repair is completed safely and correctly.
  • Local Expertise You Can Trust: As a trusted electrical contractor serving Los Angeles, CA, we understand common electrical issues in both older and modern properties. Our experience allows us to deliver reliable repairs that improve performance and prevent future problems.
Get a Free Quote
Protection. Performance. Peace of Mind.

Why Electrical Repairs and Troubleshooting Matter in Los Angeles, CA

  • Prevents Electrical Hazards: Faulty wiring and overloaded circuits can lead to serious risks like electrical fires or shocks. Professional repairs ensure your system operates safely and meets all safety standards.
  • Restores Reliable Power: Electrical issues can disrupt your daily life or business operations. Our troubleshooting services quickly restore consistent power so you can get back to normal without delays.
  • Avoids Costly Future Repairs: Ignoring small electrical problems can lead to bigger, more expensive issues. Early diagnosis and repair help extend the life of your electrical system and save money long-term.
Get a Free Quote
FREQUENTLY ASKED ・ ANSWERS TO YOUR QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions About Electrical Repairs in Los Angeles, CA

Find answers to common questions about electrical repairs, troubleshooting, safety issues, and emergency electrical service in Los Angeles.

How quickly can you fix electrical issues?

Most common electrical repairs can be completed the same day, depending on the complexity of the issue. We provide a clear timeline after diagnosing the problem.

Do you handle emergency electrical repairs?

Yes, we provide 24/7 emergency electrical repair services in Los Angeles, CA. Whether you’re dealing with a sudden power outage, exposed wiring, burning smells, or any electrical hazard, our team responds quickly to restore safety and power to your home or business.

What are common signs I need electrical repairs?

Common signs include flickering or dimming lights, frequent circuit breaker trips, burning smells, buzzing sounds, warm outlets, or sudden power loss. If those issues point to an overloaded service, we may also recommend an electrical panel upgrade. If you notice any of these issues in your Los Angeles property, it’s important to contact a professional electrician immediately to prevent safety risks and further damage.

Trusted Los Angeles Electricians for Residential and Commercial Projects

911 Construction & Electric Inc. serves homeowners, property managers, builders, and businesses throughout Los Angeles with reliable electrical repairs, panel upgrades, EV charger installation, emergency service, lighting, and construction-related electrical work. We focus on safe workmanship, honest estimates, and dependable results that protect your property and keep your project moving.

  • Licensed & Experienced Team: Skilled professionals serving residential and commercial properties across Los Angeles.
  • Code-Compliant Work: Every project is completed with safety, compliance, and long-term reliability in mind.

CUSTOMER FEEDBACK ・ WHAT CLIENTS SAY

What Clients Say About 911 Construction & Electric

See why homeowners, property managers, and businesses trust 911 Construction & Electric for responsive service, professional work, and reliable results.

FREQUENTLY ASKED ・ ANSWERS TO YOUR QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked Questions About Electricians in Los Angeles, CA

Find answers to common questions about electrical repairs, panel upgrades, EV charger installation, emergency electrician service, and residential or commercial electrical work in Los Angeles.

What areas do you serve?

911 Construction & Electric proudly serves residential and commercial clients across Los Angeles and surrounding areas, including:

Altadena, Arleta, Beverly Hills, Burbank, Calabasas, Canoga Park, Chatsworth, Eagle Rock, Encino, Glendale, Granada Hills, Hancock Park, Hollywood, La Cañada, La Crescenta, Los Angeles, Los Feliz, Melrose, Mission Hills, Montrose, North Hills, North Hollywood, Northridge, Oxnard, Pasadena, Porter Ranch, Reseda, San Fernando, San Fernando Valley, Santa Monica, Sherman Oaks, Studio City, Sunland, Tarzana, Tujunga, Sun Valley, Sylmar, Thousand Oaks, Toluca Lake, Van Nuys, West Hills, and Woodland Hills.

If you’re located nearby but don’t see your area listed, feel free to contact us, we’re happy to help whenever possible.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes, 911 Construction & Electric is fully licensed and insured. We follow all local electrical codes and safety regulations to ensure every project is completed safely, legally, and to the highest professional standards. Your property and safety are always our top priority.

How quickly can you respond to emergencies?

We offer 24/7 emergency electrical services and strive to respond as quickly as possible, often within the same day depending on your location and the urgency of the issue. Whether it’s a power outage, electrical hazard, or urgent repair, our team is ready to act fast and restore safety to your property.

Do you provide written estimates?

Absolutely. We provide clear, detailed written estimates before any work begins. Our pricing is transparent, with no hidden fees, so you know exactly what to expect from start to finish.

Do you handle both residential and commercial projects?

Yes, we specialize in both residential and commercial electrical services. From small home repairs and upgrades to large-scale commercial installations and construction projects, our team has the experience and equipment to handle jobs of all sizes.
